VZ.rationale: Verizon presents a mildly attractive fundamental picture. Q1 2026 showed solid execution: adjusted EPS of $1.28 beat consensus by $0.07, YoY revenue grew 2.9%, and the company achieved its first positive Q1 postpaid phone net adds since 2013 (+55K). Operating margins improved to ~24% (operating income $8.24B on $34.44B revenue), and ROE reached 17-19%. The company raised FY26 adjusted EPS growth guidance to 5-6% and reaffirmed $21.5B+ free cash flow target. Valuation is compelling: at a P/E of 10.7x, VZ trades near the bottom of its 12-month range (10.6-21.2x), roughly 40% below the mid-point of ~16x, suggesting the market is paying significantly less for the same earnings power than it was just months ago. The 9.3% earnings yield is attractive for a defensive, cash-generative telecom.
